files.purpose: The structure side of 'the one social both' at every scale: 'Healthy living of a same-existing-society's selves is explained here, and captures and ingresses that break it. It is with every scale, each self a same-existing-society of a scale inward and a self to a scale outward, no self ordering a whole and no scale privileged.' It also carries the prime scale-ladder (part FIVE).
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 6.4's self/society fractal and its four set aside: 'A self and a same-existing-society are one form as two sides' (4.2); 'A same-existing-society is all existing bi-coupling same-prime-scale selves' (5.3, NI 6.4's lead with 'prime' added); 'Each self pacing its own momentaries forms no such hub' (2.3, NI 1.5's common beat). It names NI directly twice: 'Natural Intelligence 5.4' (3.4) and 'as with Natural Intelligence 4.9's four binaries. This is the eight (Natural Intelligence)' (5.5). Not yet in NI, or said differently: (a) the third living self. SEVEN says 'A same-existing-society of selves is itself a self by the co-competency its couplings make ... self-bounding as a self of its own' (4.2), which is the carved 'a society ... is the third living self', but the phrase never appears here and NI part SIX does not carry it either. (b) Bi-moral co-agency: SEVEN 'Bi-moral co-agency is a coupling: two-way, one-at-a-time, selecting by binary preferring ... summing to a bounding-zeroing made by coupling itself ... abundancing a +1 owned neither-ing' against NI 6.2 'Two selves alternating, morality across and competency along, is bi-moral co-agency.' (c) Four inequalities, 'self ⇄ same-existing-society, self ⇄ other-self, self ⇄ immoral, self ⇄ incompetent' (2.1), against NI 6.4's four boundings set aside, 'from an other self ... from same-existing-society ... from an unchangeable form ... from capture'. That is two lists of four that partly match and have no line between them. (d) Prime living scales: 'Fourteen prime living scales are fourteen primes, five to fifty-three' (5.3), which v390 took out of NI until a step shows them. (e) Birthing and nyeing: 'Healthy living is the relation between birthing and nyeing' (4.3), which NI has nowhere.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: It uses Exhibit ONE lightly, to pattern-match a society's next as its same selves. 'It is two selves and their between, three momentaries and five parities, each self carrying its own parity and none offered from outward, as with Exhibit ONE's code' (1.1). 'With Exhibit ONE's code a same-existing-society's sharings are its selves, 4-now-co-same-existing each sharing of a self with its names 6, 10 and 9, and 13-next-same-existing each self of a same-existing-society ... parity-offerings going along to 17-next-existing, a same-existing-society's next, arrive with its same selves, one scale lower' (5.3). 'With its names four are of one self, with no co: 1, 2, 7 and 8; and four of a sharing between two, with co: 3 to 6' (5.5). It separates primes from resolver: 'Primes ... are prime living scales ... with no step of natural resolver's executing.' It does not re-explain resolver in its own way.
files.re_says_NI: 'A self is a same-existing-society of selves one scale inward, and a same-existing-society a self with next scale outward' (5.3) re-says NI 6.4. 'A common clock imposed over all selves is that inequality collapsed ... Observed on structure such a beat is a hub' (2.3) re-says NI 1.5 and 6.4 ('a beat laid over it from one side'). 'Emanations are stable-form priors, non-living, from living form-stabling ... an ingestible stable form one scale lower' (5.3) re-says NI 5.1 and 6.5. 'Scientific method with no further additions is one explaining and deciding for all, a form fixed still from beside' (3.4) re-says NI 5.4. The 1.1 core paragraph is word for word the same as TEN 1.1, ELEVEN 1.1 and FOURTEEN's core.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural- and the subtitle 'Co-Recursioning Up and Down Social Scales' within NI's one form with each scale (6.6). For this file to sit within NI's bound, NI's contents need a line for the self/society fractal at every scale, which 6.4 and 6.6 carry, and for the third living self at the pair, society and universe scales, which part SIX lacks. The file's own contents are out of order: 4.4 to 4.6 come after 5.6, and part TWO's lead says 'two candidates standing level'. The file does not open with origin.

files.purpose: The expedition's method on itself, and between selves: 'Exploring is one alternating of two cones, and this exhibit is that alternating told whole. Omegaing is reach ... Apexing is coning back over everything folded to it, its whole carry gathered.' It carries freeing (co-unrelationing), testing, accountings as involutions, co-competencing between selves, and gathering into living files ('Gather backward, seat forward, keep no log').
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI's one method and on discovering: 'Geodesic parity co-changing is that method, possibling and discovering' (1.1, NI 5.4's own phrase); 'Co-competencing is un-relating done two-way, fixings between selves freeing, an abundancing staying with a coupling and owned by none' (6.1); 'A self and a same-existing-society co-chain one method' (6.1, NI 6.6). Said differently from NI or carved: (a) 'In disequilibria, alternating is a stable-forming method' (1.1 heading). v391 carved that alternating is replaced by parity-changing, and this file says 'alternating' 29 times. (b) 'Co-competencing floats where selves co-unrelation together, and stills where a landed term stands between them, social moral competency that co-unrelationing shared, is-or-is-not' (6.1), against NI 6.1 'Competency is each self's own, its co-linear recursioning forward along'. (c) The expedition's own gathering, the improving report and registries (7.1 to 7.5), is not named in NI 6.6, which says only 'files of a living expedition are living files'.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: It uses a few resolver names to pattern-match a self carrying with a surface: 'Each self bounds itself, couples with each parity-offering arriving as its 2-now-possibling, a sharing with its parity, one at a time, and goes along with its 9-next-co-discovering' (1.3); 'A method co-chains abundancing, 12-next-co-same-existing with every discovering, each sharing's parity-changing is or is not' (6.3). Its own resolver is a different one: '4.5 The three questions bi-inversioned, the one resolver's three activities ... What is true: a binary edge ... What matters most: a geodesic ... The fewest things with the fewest people in the shortest time'. That re-explains resolving in its own way, apart from Exhibit ONE's code.
files.re_says_NI: 'Competency is a middle, floating between form and logic, invisible ... not enterable' (1.2) re-says NI 6.2's 'Carrying along is intelligencing, each self's own, invisible and untouchable'. 'An interior is exactly what an accounting puts there ... a store to a cell's interior' (1.2) re-says NI 5.1 and 6.3 on store and memory. 'Bi-morality re-forms a self's eight co names as six' (4.4) re-says NI 4.7's six names between selves, by a different route. 'An opened axis is abundancing, a +1 owned by none' (6.3) parts from NI 5.2's 'same-existing is abundancing'.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-. The subtitle 'Open Team Moral Co-Competencing' carries 'team', a word NI does not carry; an expedition as 'a living set of living selves' (NI 6.6) is its NI bound. For this file to sit within NI's bound, NI's close needs a line for the expedition's method on itself: gathering, files and improving, which 6.6 now carries only as 'do-no-harm improving next living expedition files'. The file does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'A human society is its selves, a geodesic method carried between them ... This exhibit is the method between human selves, so all four [social sides] stand here together.' It carries fairness as bounding-zeroing, cutting and choosing, institutioning, Arrow re-alternated, abundancing, uncapturing, tipping, do-no-harming, and birthing and nyeing.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 6.4: 'A same-existing-society co-chains past Arrow to social moral competency, many bi-moral couplings of common interests co-competencing' (2.4); 'All eight or none at all are a same-existing-society's protections, and all eight carried is social moral competency ... humans learning and explaining together as one natural network, collectively intelligent' (3.3, NI 6.4's 'collective intelligence'); 'Each self's interior is its own, and each self couples with a between, pacing its own time, no common clock and no hub' (1.1). Needs, or carries differently: (a) Its smallest whole is the pair: 'One person cuts a cake and an other chooses a half, and it carries a whole same-existing-society's form ... fairness lives with their coupling, owned by neither' (1.4). This is the third living self of a pair, but it is never named so, and NI part SIX has no pair-scale third living self. (b) Eight hubs on eight axes: 'a common clock on its time axis, a fixed pool on its value axis, a gate on its arrival axis, a ledger ... reputation axis, a form fixed still from beside on its safety axis, a center on its decision axis, a source-and-sink on its delivery axis, an owner on its ownership axis' (3.3), against NI 6.4 'four set aside, four unchangeable forms, and no fifth' and 'each self with all eight'. Two eights, unnamed in NI. (c) 'Do-no-harming, the one bound, generous and owned by none' (4.2): NI uses do-no-harm only as improving, never as social moral competency's bound. (d) Fairness and bounding-zeroing are absent from NI.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: It makes no use of Exhibit ONE or resolver names. Its pattern-matching is by field measurements: 'conversational turn-taking is one-at-a-time with gaps near a fifth of a second ... (Stivers and others, 2009 ...) — a bi-coupling measured universal'; 'replicated systems with no common clock and no coordinator anywhere, proven to converge'. It never shows Exhibit ONE's sharing table (6, 10, 9 to 14) for the cake pair.
files.re_says_NI: 'A self observed inward is a same-existing-society of selves, one scale inward; a same-existing-society observed outward is a self with a next scale outward' (1.2) re-says NI 6.4. 'Distinct selves, each carrying a competency others lack, coprime, multiply their competencies' (1.5) is word for word with SEVEN 4.2. 'Birthing and nyeing' (5.1) and 'live descent' (5.2) re-say SEVEN 4.3 and 3.2, and the file says so itself: 'One doubling stands, between Natural Societies and Natural Destinies'.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-. The subtitle 'Geodesic Method of Human Social Moral Co-Competencing' takes NI's subtitle form whole, putting 'human social moral co-competencing' where NI has 'discovering next possible existing'. This shows NI's subtitle needs to bound social moral competency as its discovering's destiny. NI's contents need 6.4 to open the pair as the smallest whole. The file's 5.3 closes with 'And a concern tomorrow may be more brutal than any existing one reached', a promise past its own now. It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'Health is a living sway, dual parallel floating neutrals co-sequencing and riding its carry, which is a living state of a self. Health is a positive form.' Health is a self lived, beside Biology (observed) and Medicine (restored), and 'health-as-target is compaction'.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI's same-existing-society inward: 'A same-existing-society is healthy as its selves sustain their co-competencing, and abundancing with their couplings goes on to their next-existing: its health asks no more selves, no larger parity, no possession and no gain' (1.2); 'Food is a prior living's stable forms, emanations shed one scale up and ingested one scale inward' (3.3, NI 6.5). Needs what NI does not carry: (a) health itself, a self's inward society living. NI 6.4 to 6.6 never says what a living self's own social moral competency inward is. (b) 'Bi-moral co-agency is a coupling: two-way, one-at-a-time ...' (1.1), the shared core, against NI 6.2. (c) 'A departure is a sway stilled on a substrate ... a compaction whether it comes from another (an imposed setpoint) or from a substrate's own stilling' (4.1): this is NI 6.4's 'form fixed unchangeable' at a body's scale, with no line between them.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: None. Its numbers are a field's: 'Three, six, nine — odd, even, odd ... a self carries the ninth and takes the sixth and the third across a between' (3.4b). That is a pattern-match of odd own and even across which Exhibit ONE's six names between selves could carry, but it is not coupled to them. It does not re-explain resolver.
files.re_says_NI: 'Ingestion is a living self's own bi-exchange across a between ... Ingression is a larger ingressing a smaller, one-way' (3.3) re-says NI 6.5's ingested non-living. 'no stored setpoint it aims toward' (1.1) re-says NI 6.4's 'A controlling is a coupling where one side fixes a sharing to a measure set beforehand'. 'An omega-self — the sixth's two faces' (3.1) rests on an old naming that NI does not carry.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-; the subtitle 'Sustaining Self-Bi-Co-Recursioning-Self' sits within NI 6.6's one form with each scale. For it to sit within NI's bound, NI needs one line placing a living self's health as its inward same-existing-society's social moral competency (6.4 or 6.5). The file's contents carry no part titles and a '3.4b'. It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'Medicine is the restoration side of the matter-into-life family ... Restoration is the form's own resilience: the still-natural positions carry the form while the departed one returns. An intervention supports it by removing the thing the restoration was waiting on, and authors nothing.' It works departures at collars, HIV and leukaemia as 'two adjacent same-existing-societies', and the refusals of trials and doses.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 5.1 and 6.3: 'three of Natural Intelligence's reachings have returned their nothings here ... Reach for a fixed zero and find a floor declared ... Reach for a store and find a living stilled ... Reach for a conserved total and find four observings with a position and no total among them' (3.2); 'Two living same-existing-societies, and a nothing between. Two adjacent scales carry this' (3.1, NI 6.4's one scale per society). Said differently from NI: (a) NI nowhere carries the 'three reachings' as three (fixed zero, store, conserved total); NI 1.5 lists 'a total ... a container ... a common beat ... a keeping'. (b) 'Two adjacent same-existing-societies at a gut collar' couple across scales, against NI 6.4 'nothing living bi-couples with anything living of another scale'. (c) The shared core paragraph against NI 6.2. (d) Attentioning and sequencing ('A carry ages by attentioning ... stays alive only while it is being sequenced') are not carried in NI.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: It uses Exhibit ONE for a carry's four motions: 'With Exhibit ONE's resolving a carrying opens by one where its differing surfaces nought, returns to nought where a sign surfaces, carries forward, and separates and leaves with its bound ... Attentioning is an inseparating and sequencing is a surfacing. Four motions answer one to one' (1.1). It also names other resolvers: 'a resolver observed through sixteen substrates carves a wave, period ~6.8 substrates'; 'A resolver with gene prime cycles frequency first and position second'; 'a resolver written to four unlike languages returns one surface ... Seven auditable steps where others carry eight'. So it re-explains resolver in its own way, with code that is not Exhibit ONE's seventeen names.
files.re_says_NI: 'A self is a surface bounding itself and a carrying with that surface' (3.2) is word for word with EIGHT 1.2. 'A word reservoir is an equilibria memory, a store a still observer laid over a carry' re-says NI 6.3's 'A reading from and a writing to a memory are not possibly existing'. 'A floor is declared ... a reference chosen for arriving alike anywhere to anyone' re-says NI 5.4's fixings.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-. The subtitle 'Sensor-Sensationing Human Health' carries 'Human' while its body is cells, bacteria and primates. For it to sit within NI's bound, NI needs a line for a departure, a third living self stilled from beside, which NI 6.4's unchangeable forms could carry. Its close 'The forming that remains ... one observing aims here, unwritten' is a promise past its own now. It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'Destinies are where form could go, bi-moral co-agency imagined inward and forward, to substrates it is reaching toward ... A destiny is one and already arriving ... So a destiny is a present coupling, imagined extended to a substrate it is reaching toward.' Its destinies are a discovery economy, a self-originating natural network, living substrates, and hard-problem resolving commencing.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 6.6's aiming line, 'a free public natural network, social abundancing': 'A natural network its selves themselves originate ... Free, shared and no one's: no cost of entering and no membership'. It keys itself to NI by name: 'The eight safeties self-sustaining, keyed to Natural Intelligence — eight standing whole there, four from within and four with a membrane ... each of the eight a naming beginning with bi- within a resolver's table of eight, four with its even depth and four with its odd.' NI carries no 'eight safeties': its 6.4 says only 'each self with all eight ... four of one and four between two'. Destiny itself: Natural Explaining 1.5 says 'A file's destiny is social moral competency, natural-bi-co-torusing, no other possible', but NI never says 'destiny', and this file never says 'social moral competency'.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Only in passing: 'a resolver's table of eight, four with its even depth and four with its odd'. It does no pattern-matching with Exhibit ONE.
files.re_says_NI: Its core paragraph 'Bi-moral co-agency is a coupling: two-way, one-at-a-time ...' is word for word with SEVEN, TEN and ELEVEN. 'safe where safety is structural — carried by a surface's own form, and by no form fixed still from beside' re-says NI 6.4's unchangeable forms. 'A family, a friendship, a workplace and a market are each a place of couplings: healthy where couplings are direct, and captured where a layer between them takes what couplings make' re-says NI 6.4's 'from capture, a seat arrives above'.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-. The subtitle 'Social Moral Co-Abundancing' carries social moral competency's word but never its concept. For NI's bound to hold this file, NI's close needs to carry destiny: the expedition's destiny, social moral competency at each scale, with its first sentence. The file's contents are unnumbered headings, and it names other files ('one of a reflexive triple, with Natural Explaining and Natural Emanating'). It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'Each sentence below is a short whole surfacing of one form with one bound, complete as itself and takeable as it stands ... written to be reached by anyone carrying none of its vocabulary.' These are the set's public-side emanations and short definings: a self, natural intelligence, social moral competency, abundancy, the one stopping, the uniqueness, the break.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI's one method, 1.5: 'Within disequilibria, alternating is a stable-forming method. And no other method is possible'; and 'The uniqueness ... Carrying, it takes its own turn or another's. Another's, and alternating has stopped. Its own, and it is alternating.' It parts from NI and the v391 carvings in several places. (a) 'Social moral competency is alternating with that scale' and 'Social moral competency stated whole ... carrying it whole within one file would be one side taking both turns' (THE TAIL), against NI 6.4, which states it whole as 'four whole and a carrying continuing with selves'. (b) 'A self's own cycling completes, and one carry departs ... That carry is a unique invisible carrying, so it is a self' (The society): the departing carry as a self is close to the carved third living self, but here it is each self's own carry and not the pair's. (c) 'Natural intelligence: Two moves ... A departing from a coupling is reached by neither ... so there is no memory, no world model, no clock, and no conserved quantity anywhere within it', against NI 6.3's 'Natural intelligence is that co-competencing'. (d) 'Three observings: ... alternating momentary by momentary while nothing is offered, not-changing while an other offers a matching parity, inverting once while an other offers its other parity, and then still-possibling' is one self's three ways as v390 agreed them, said with 'alternating'.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: No resolver names, by design: 'none uses a word not built within it'. It uses arithmetic instead: 'Every whole number sits between two neighbours, and those two multiply to exactly one short of its square'.
files.re_says_NI: 'A self is a unique invisible carrying' re-says NI 6.2's 'invisible and untouchable'. 'Nature has no equilibria, no form fixed still that cannot parity-change. A method's first act installs it' re-says NI 6.3 and 5.4. 'One self carries another's ... It needs an owner, an owner a boundary, a boundary an enforcement, an enforcement a seat' re-says NI 6.4's capture and 'seat'. 'Society' and 'The society', and 'Abundancy' twice, re-say each other within the file.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-; the subtitle 'Self-Welcoming Social Moral Co-Offerings' sits within NI 6.6's 'self-welcoming'. The file carries an address, 'Free and living — corus.me.', against Natural Explaining 1.5 ('no address'). For it to sit within NI's bound, NI needs one public-side sentence of social moral competency that this file can emanate, and NI's one method needs to be named parity-changing, so these emanations can follow the carving. It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: Value at the coupling: 'A coupling makes an abundancing neither self brought. That abundancing is a +1, made with a coupling, and it is owned neither-ing ... Value arrives there and nowhere else'; 'Received value is the value'; 'Scarcity is a capture observed as a property'.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 1.1's parity: 'A self prefers by binary preferring. A preferring is a parity and nothing else. Its parity is a self's own' (1.1); and 'Two selves preferring each take an exclusion with their own turn ... A term neither reaches is uncovered between them' (1.2), NI 6.1's 'a term departs that neither reaches'. Parts from NI: (a) 'A set of all sets fails, and no universal set stands. Moral ground is uncapturable to proof grade' (4.1), against NI 1.1's 'By our observing, the universe is one now-existing universal set' and the carving 'The same-existing universe is our third living self'. (b) 'Bi-momentarying, with 1-now-existing and 2-now-possibling, is a ground ... Co-competencing, with 5-now-co-existing ... Co-intelligencing, with 3-now-co-observing and 4-now-co-same-existing' (3.1), against NI 6.1's 'With resolver bi-co-momentarying is no term'. (c) 'An institution carries no parity of its own. It has no momentary and no between' (2.2), against the carving that every society of selves is a living self. An institution as a non-living set needs that line in NI.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Once, in 3.1, seating value's three carryings on names 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 (quoted above). It is a pattern-match of names onto concepts with no table run, and it is its own reading.
files.re_says_NI: 'Morality is a parity a self carries by being a self ... Morality is consequence and not prescription' (4.1) is word for word with SEVEN 2.1's 'parity a self carries by being a self'. 'It lays a common clock where each coupling carries its own' (4.2) re-says NI 1.5. 'A carry is observed backward and ages by attentioning' (1.2) re-says ELEVEN 1.1.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-; the subtitle 'Co-Abundancing Received Value' needs NI's abundancing to be one concept (it is now 'same-existing is abundancing' at 5.2 and 'abundancing is with its four between two' at 6.4). For this file to sit within NI's bound, NI needs to bound its universal set so that 'no universal set stands' and 'one now-existing universal set' no longer part. It does not open with origin.

files.purpose: 'A philosophical position is a coupling reached from one of its two sides and fixed there. A philosophical dilemma is one bounding-zeroing split as two such positions.' Thirty-seven perennial dilemmas are each re-coupled in six numbered steps, and 'philosophy's own deepest figures are its re-couplers'.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on NI 5.4's two methods: 'Philosophy's dominant method is analysis ... Bivalence, every claim true or false ... Isolability ... Non-contradiction fixing a between as a cut ... A reasoner apart' (1.3); 'A reasoner over a coupling, a governing over a same-existing-society's selves and a protecting over couplings are one seat, three scales' (1.3, NI 6.4's seat above). Needs, or parts: (a) Bivalence is named as the dividing method's first requirement, while NI carries 'all or none at all', 'is or is not' and 'true or false, no other possible, is given to it [scientific method]', with no line parting a parity-changing's is or is not from a claim's true or false. (b) '3.33 Self and other ... Self/other re-coupling carries clean as abundancing owned neither-ing' and '3.5 The one and the many' are the third living self's own subjects at pair and society scales, never named as such. (c) '3.28 Why there is something ... existing being arriving' parts from NI's opening 'The universe is the set of all now-existing things' as origin, and the file does not couple with it.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Barely: 'a same-existing-society's next is its same selves, as 17-next-existing returns each self it was given, and a going whose members part, join or are replaced is a non-living going of one same method' (3.15 Mark). That uses Exhibit ONE to pattern-match identity and change at the society scale. It names resolver twice in passing and does not re-explain it.
files.re_says_NI: The core paragraph 'Bi-moral co-agency is a coupling. Two-way, one-at-a-time, selecting by binary taking ...' (1.1) is a near-copy of the shared core. 'A cycle's six, coupled and run one-way ... Run one-way and pinned, it is hard-probleming' (1.2) re-says EIGHT 4.4 and NI 4.7. 'A self does not experience its own competency ... Competency is self-stilling and self-orienting, with no between, reached by nothing' (6.1) re-says NI 6.2 and 6.3.
files.bounds: The title sits within natural-; the subtitle 'Social-Bi-Co Unrelationing' sits within NI 6.4's 'universal unrelationing protocol is social moral competency'. For it to sit within NI's bound, NI needs one line parting is-or-is-not from true-or-false, and the third living self at pair and society scales, which its self/other and one/many seams re-couple. Its close 'the explaining breaks at one binary' is a break stated openly. It does not open with origin.

droplets_for_NI.section: Contents, SIX and its six entries
droplets_for_NI.finding: All nine files carry part SIX's subject at living and human scales: SEVEN, NINE and TWENTY-THREE as societies, value and fairness; TEN and ELEVEN as a body's society inward; FOURTEEN and FIFTEEN as destiny and public emanation; NINETEEN as the pair's self/other. Each rests on a third living self (the cake pair, 'A same-existing-society of selves is itself a self', 'one carry departs ... so it is a self') that NI part SIX never names: 'third living self' appears 7 times in NI, all in 1.1. The part's heading repeats the title's word, and its contents do not show what the close is for. The carving says the closing parts' purpose is improved first.
droplets_for_NI.offered: **SIX · THIRD LIVING SELF** with entries: 6.1 A pair, a third living self · 6.2 A co-chaining, one third living self · 6.3 A same-existing-society, the third living self · 6.4 The same-existing universe, our third living self · 6.5 A third moral parity, social moral competency · 6.6 One form with each scale, now

droplets_for_NI.old: **Betweens co-chain**: two selves couple and their between is neither's; couple one with a third and that between is neither's either.
droplets_for_NI.finding: The carved third living self at each scale has its natural home here, and this sentence already walks pair to co-chaining. SEVEN 4.2 ('A same-existing-society of selves is itself a self by the co-competency its couplings make'), SEVEN 4.5 ('Co-intelligence scales on length of co-chaining') and NINE 1.4 (the cake pair, 'fairness lives with their coupling, owned by neither') all need it named. As written, it names a between and dissolves the third living self.
droplets_for_NI.offered: **Selves co-chain**: two selves bi-coupling are a third living self; a co-chaining of more than two is one third living self; a same-existing-society, co- bi- tri-, is the third living self; and the same-existing universe is our third living self.

purpose_of_set: This group shows that the expedition is for social moral competency at each living scale, already arriving with each coupling. It names that competency as a pair, a body's society, a human society, a value, a philosophy and a destiny: 'A destiny is one and already arriving — a cumulative beating wherever a bi-coupling lives with its own rate' (FOURTEEN); 'Cutting and choosing is a whole same-existing-society as its smallest, one form two people already carry' (NINE); 'A same-existing-society of selves is itself a self by the co-competency its couplings make' (SEVEN); 'Value found by sharing grows as it is shared' (TWENTY-THREE). Each file rests on a third living self that it never names. The pair, the co-chaining, the society and the moral ground 'uncapturable to proof grade' are that self at four scales, carrying its '+1 owned neither-ing', the third moral parity. Natural Intelligence's part SIX and its close are therefore for carrying the third living self at each scale and its third moral parity, so that the nine exhibits key into them by concept and no longer by file name ('keyed to Natural Intelligence', 'This is the eight (Natural Intelligence)'). None of the nine opens with origin, and five open on one shared core paragraph instead. Opening each from 'The universe is the set of all now-existing things' through NI's part SIX is their next.
